name: Make
description: Make is an automation platform with credit-based plans: Free, Core, Pro, Teams and Enterprise, plus a Start-up plan.
features: Data stores and execution storage allowances
strengths: Free plan with 1,000 credits per month
limitations: Prices were not shown in the page we read
Credits expire at the end of the term

free.details: 1,000 credits per month, 1 MB data storage and 1 data store.

notes: The page says prices are cheaper with annual payment in advance but gives no figures. The Start-up Plan discounts Business by 50% for teams under 20 employees.

verification.notes: Product active (visual automation; credits are the billing unit). The pricing page FAQ confirms the Free plan has 1,000 credits per month, and that Core, Pro and Teams are paid plans (annual payment is cheaper than monthly; Enterprise accepts wire transfer). The plan cards and their prices are not present in the page text this browser could read, so no paid price is recorded. Needs manual review.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

keyFeature: Visual automation platform for connecting apps

profile.headline: Visual automation with AI agents, built by prompting or drag and drop

capabilities.title: Build an automation your way
capabilities.text: Create workflows by prompting, by dragging and dropping modules, or through MCP.

capabilities.title: Set goals for AI agents
capabilities.text: Give an agent a goal, tools and limits, and view its reasoning.

capabilities.title: Run Make from your AI assistant
capabilities.text: The Make MCP Server lets you build and run automations from Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini.

capabilities.title: Add code when you need control
capabilities.text: Use JavaScript or Python inside a scenario.

featureCards.name: Workflow Builder
featureCards.text: The visual canvas where scenarios are built, tested and debugged.

featureCards.name: AI Agents
featureCards.text: Agents that work towards a goal using the tools you give them.

featureCards.name: 3,500+ app integrations
featureCards.text: Connect apps out of the box, and add a custom integration for any app with an API.

featureCards.name: Observability
featureCards.text: Monitor your stack live, including third-party resources.

featureCards.name: Governance
featureCards.text: Role-based access, audit logs and real-time analytics.

featureCards.name: Security
featureCards.text: The site lists GDPR compliance, SOC 2 Type II and SOC 3, encryption and SSO.

audienceDetail.text: Build by prompting, drag-and-drop or from an AI chat.
Add custom code and custom integrations where needed.
Marketing, sales, operations, IT, finance and customer experience teams are named.
The site describes roles that view all automations and follow team activity.

scenarios.title: Connect dealership interactions
scenarios.text: A customer example on the site describes an AI voice agent built with Make.

scenarios.title: Scale up automations across a company
scenarios.text: A customer on the site reports more than 100 automated processes.

scenarios.title: Let a large team build quickly
scenarios.text: Another customer says its 300+ employees can innovate in hours, not weeks.

gettingStarted.text: Sign up for the free plan; the site says no credit card is needed and the plan has no time limit.
Start by prompting, dragging in modules, or working from an AI chat.
For larger deployments, talk to sales or review the paid plans.
